regime_context: The detector shows a broad but narrowing eligible rotation (21/49 themes eligible) led by AI Infrastructure with high breadth but fading valuation and mixed trend health. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg and is helping on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so the frame is trend-discipline/vol-awareness rather than return prediction; cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is weak and rotation timing is display-only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the AI Infrastructure leader (SMH proxy) hands off to Cybersecurity (CIBR) or Semicap Equipment on a CONFIRMED basis: the leaders' score margin (0.651) must compress and CIBR or a dedicated semicap-equipment measure must overtake AI Infra in the rotation rank AND hold that rank for two consecutive weekly prints before I treat the handoff as real.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Ranked #2, eligible, with the strongest durability_bar in the set (0.85), hurst_tag 'trend' (cleanest trend-health of top themes), and breadth 1.0 — every constituent participating. This is a coherent, broad, trend-healthy narrative. Crowding_z of 1.95 is the clear caution — it is the most crowded of the leading themes — so treat as size-down only, not a fade.
theses.dissent: The crowding flag is clustering_extreme: when breadth is already 1.0 and crowding is this high, incremental marginal money may already be exhausted; the theme could stall on any rate/software multiple compression even as it remains durable in name.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by more than 5% on a total-return basis before the check-by date

theses.subject: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
theses.thesis: Ranked #3, eligible, durability_bar 0.79, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.938, and crowding_z only 0.86 (not crowded). This offers trend participation in the semis complex without the same crowding pressure as Cybersecurity or Non-AI Tech. It is adjacent to — but distinct from — the AI Infra leader, so it is a theme-level overweight, not a fade of the leader.
theses.dissent: Shares the SMH proxy with AI Infrastructure and AI Semiconductors, so it is not independent; a single drawdown in the semis complex hits all four themes at once, and the margin of the AI Infra leader (0.651) is still wide, meaning capital may keep concentrating in the leader rather than rotating to equipment.

falsifier.text: SMH underperforms SPY by more than 7% on a total-return basis before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Ranked #5 but eligible=false: the absolute-trend gate has closed. durability_bar is 0.14 (near the bottom of the set), hurst_tag 'mean-revert', breadth 0.125 — the trend structure is broken and only one in eight names is participating. The one validated leg (the gate) says this is a shake-out risk zone, not a dip buy.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus a non-crowded posture could allow a sharp snap-back rally if precious metals catch a bid; avoiding it risks missing the first leg of a reversal, though that is exactly the kind of capture the gate is designed to forfeit.

falsifier.text: SIL is above its 200-day moving average and closes higher than today on 15 of the next 20 sessions
